title: readiness-checklist template variables
description: Values for templates/readiness-checklist.md.j2 and templates/readiness-checklist.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from readiness-checklist.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

artefact_date.description: On what date was this readiness assessment made, as YYYY-MM-DD? Readiness decays - a score with no date is quoted a year later as if it still held.
